description: Add read receipts to DM messages and change notification criteria. When a user reads a message, broadcast read status to other participants via streaming. Show a read indicator on sent messages. Only send notification sound/increment unread when the recipient has NOT read the DM (i.e., is not currently viewing the chat room).
steps: 1. Backend - Modify the read endpoint in app/controllers/api/v1/dm/chat_rooms_controller.rb: After updating membership's last_read_message_id, broadcast a 'dm_read_receipt' event to the chat room's other participants via Redis streaming. The payload should include: { chat_room_id, account_id (reader), last_read_message_id }. Use the same redis publish pattern as PushDmMessageWorker.

2. Backend - Modify app/serializers/rest/dm_chat_room_serializer.rb: Add a 'read_receipts' attribute that returns an array of { account_id, last_read_message_id } for all active participants (excluding the current_account). This lets the frontend know which messages have been read by whom.
3. Frontend - Update app/javascript/mastodon/api_types/dm.ts: Add ReadReceipt type { account_id: string; last_read_message_id: string } and add read_receipts?: ReadReceipt[] to ApiDmChatRoomJSON.

4. Frontend - Update app/javascript/mastodon/reducers/dm.ts: Add readReceipts to DmChatRoom type (record of account_id -> last_read_message_id). Add a new action type DM_READ_RECEIPT_RECEIVED that updates the readReceipts for a room. Handle it in the normalizeChatRoom function and in the reducer.
5. Frontend - Update app/javascript/mastodon/actions/dm.ts: Export new action type DM_READ_RECEIPT_RECEIVED.

6. Frontend - Update app/javascript/mastodon/actions/streaming_dm.ts: Handle the new 'dm_read_receipt' event by dispatching DM_READ_RECEIPT_RECEIVED with the payload. This allows real-time read receipt updates.

7. Frontend - Update app/javascript/mastodon/features/dm/components/message_item.tsx: Accept a new prop 'isRead' (boolean). When isOwn is true and isRead is true, show a read indicator below the timestamp (a small '읽음' text or double check mark icon). Add appropriate styling in dm.scss.

8. Frontend - Update app/javascript/mastodon/features/dm/components/message_list.tsx: Compute whether each own message has been read by looking at the room's readReceipts. A message is 'read' if any other participant's last_read_message_id >= message.id. Pass isRead prop to MessageItem.

9. Frontend - Notification change: The streaming_dm.ts already checks isActiveRoom and only plays sound/increments unread when !isActiveRoom. This matches the requirement. The backend mark_others_unread in dm_message.rb always marks others as unread when a message is sent - this is correct because if they're viewing the room, the frontend will immediately call markAsRead. No changes needed for notification criteria - it already works correctly.
10. Add 'read' / '읽음' i18n string to en.json and ko.json for the read receipt indicator.
acceptance_criteria: The read endpoint broadcasts a dm_read_receipt event via Redis streaming to other participants
The chat room serializer includes read_receipts array with each participant's last_read_message_id
The frontend reducer handles DM_READ_RECEIPT_RECEIVED events and stores read receipt data
The streaming handler processes dm_read_receipt events from WebSocket
Own messages show a read indicator when the recipient has read up to that message
The read indicator text is localized (en: 'Read', ko: '읽음')
verification: Run: cd /projects/sandbox/mastodon && npx tsc --noEmit --project tsconfig.json 2>&1 | head -50
Verify read indicator in message_item: grep -n 'isRead\|read' app/javascript/mastodon/features/dm/components/message_item.tsx
findings: All acceptance criteria met. TypeScript compiles cleanly. Backend broadcasts dm_read_receipt event via Redis pub/sub to other participants. Frontend handles the event in streaming, stores read receipts in reducer, and displays a localized read indicator on own messages. No notification criteria changes needed - existing logic already handles it correctly.
